## The Numbers From September 6

Let's break down today's performance by the data. We went 10-5 across 15 MLB matchups, hitting 66.7% accuracy. That's above our target threshold of 60%, and the confidence levels tell an interesting story about where our model performed strongest.

## Confidence Tier Analysis

Here's what the numbers show: Our 61% confidence picks went 3-1 (75% success rate). The 60% confidence tier delivered 2-2 (50% hit rate). Most interesting? The 50% confidence coin flips went 2-0. The Brewers miss at 53% was our only sub-55% loss.

## The Misses Worth Noting

Four losses came at different confidence levels. The Rays-Rangers upset (61% confidence) stands out—our model favored Tampa Bay's road performance, but Texas delivered at home. The Giants-Mets miss at 60% shows how September roster expansions create volatility. The Cubs-Marlins outcome? Miami's 2.1 runs per game average suggested otherwise, but baseball doesn't always follow season-long trends.

## What The Data Says About Tomorrow

No games scheduled for September 7. The league takes a collective breath, which gives us time to recalibrate our models with today's fresh data points. When action resumes on Sep 8, we'll have incorporated these 15 results into our confidence algorithms.
